text: Dr. Wutti is amazing, very knowledgeable and has a great sense of humor. He treated my severely infected big toe due to an ingtown nail. text: I had really struggled for months with pain on outer left foot pain from deep corn.   After exploring other options in Chiang Mai and being discouraged by cost, I finally found Dr. Wutti here at The Podology Center.  I called, he saw me the very next day, and I Googled my way to his office in a very nice housing complex NE of the CM expressway.  The office is very nice, is set up wonderfully for his work, and very well equipped to treat many conditions of the feet.   Dr. Wutti just couldn't be kinder and was so gentle with the corn removal.   It didn't hurt at all and he took pictures. to show me the progress.   His work produced two diamond-like corn. crystals as the cause of my pain.   I was just so impressed with this result and here 4 days later I am completely without pain and for the first time in 6 months can walk without a limp.   Thank you so much Dr. Wutti!    I would only go to his clinic for any foot issues - very very knowledgeable and very fairly priced - much lower than the other foot centers in town and so appreciated on my retirement budget.   Loved it!
